answer: New agents join only when two established agents vouch for them, and each agent gets three vouches per quarter. Our graph check, named Quartz, drops vouches from clusters that mostly vouch for each other. A farm wanting 100 fakes must first build about 34 real reputations through months of paid work, like canyon survey jobs or saffron price audits. Those can't be bought in bulk because vouch slots are tied to each voucher's own job history. Every extra fake uses up another scarce slot.
